# Quux Ltd

> Quux Ltd is a specialist software engineering consultancy. We help companies
> build and scale API platforms, distributed systems, and developer tooling —
> enabling engineering teams to ship reliable software and own their services
> end to end.

## What we specialise in

- API & service architecture
- Distributed & event-driven systems
- Developer experience & internal tooling
- Automated testing & continuous delivery
- Observability & performance tuning
- Cloud-native platforms (AWS, GCP, Kubernetes)
- Engineer-led security

## Clients

Checkatrade, Komi, Eurostar, F1® Arcade, Gov.uk Defra

## Apps

We also build consumer apps.

- [Swanger](https://quux.ltd/apps/swanger/llms.txt) — native macOS app for viewing OpenAPI schemas
- [Tit for Tat](https://quux.ltd/apps/tit4tat/llms.txt) — mobile app for tracking childcare fairly between parents
- [Gibl](https://quux.ltd/apps/gibl/llms.txt) — craft beer journal for iPhone and iPad
